name: analytics-skills
description: Skills library for product data scientists working with Claude. Experiments, cohorting, SQL modeling, regression, causal inference, and readouts.

categories.experimentation: A/B test design, analysis, causal inference

skills.name: ab-test-design
skills.description: Design A/B tests with power analysis, MDE, sample size, and a pre-registration checklist.

skills.name: ab-test-analysis
skills.description: Analyze A/B test results with significance, confidence intervals, guardrails, and a readout.

skills.name: cohort-analysis
skills.description: Build cohort retention tables and curves with one consistent denominator policy.

skills.name: funnel-analysis
skills.description: Build a step-by-step funnel with conversion rates and drop-off diagnosis.

skills.name: metric-definition
skills.description: Write a metric spec with grain, owner, source, guardrails, and known caveats.

skills.name: modular-sql-ctes
skills.description: Refactor SQL into staging / intermediate / fact CTE layers with explicit grain.

skills.name: data-quality-audit
skills.description: Run a structured audit on a table: nulls, duplicates, freshness, schema, and PK uniqueness.

skills.name: logistic-regression
skills.description: Fit, evaluate, and interpret a logistic regression for binary outcomes (churn, conversion).

skills.name: linear-regression
skills.description: Fit, evaluate, and interpret a linear regression for continuous outcomes.

skills.name: survival-analysis
skills.description: Run censoring-aware time-to-event analysis with Kaplan-Meier and Cox PH models.

skills.name: stakeholder-readout
skills.description: Write a stakeholder-ready readout with TL;DR, evidence, decision, and next steps.

skills.name: warehouse-query-optimization
skills.description: Diagnose slow Snowflake queries (clustering, pruning, joins, spilling) and propose fixes.

skills.name: causal-inference
skills.description: Estimate causal effects without RCTs using DiD, matching, or IV with a decision framework.
